title: artemisia borealis f. wormskioldii
intro: Artemisia borealis f. wormskioldii, commonly known as Wormskjold's Artemisia or Northern Sweet Annie, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving coughs, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Artemisia borealis f. wormskioldii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which may aid in the relief of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
